'''Shandar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and one of [[Ukabi]]'s [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was defeated by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]-allied individual.
